note: One entry per image slot. `source` is a decision, and `why` records it. Slots with source 'shoot' render as a flagged flat block until a real shoot exists — see docs/SHOT-LIST.md. Never hand-draw an SVG of a person, a body, a food item or a piece of equipment.

slots.why: A real gym environment. Generated gym interiors reliably produce impossible equipment geometry, and equipment that a lifter can see is wrong undermines the one thing this brand sells.
slots.prompt: A loaded Olympic barbell resting on rubber gym flooring, shot low and close at 35mm, hard directional light raking from the upper left, deep shadow filling the right third of the frame. Cool near-black environment, one warm highlight on the knurling. Negative space reserved in the upper third for a headline. No people, no faces, no visible branding.

slots.why: Brand composition with exact typography and negative space. Nothing photographic is required and nothing photographic would be more useful.
slots.prompt: Flat brand card: near-black #0b0e12 ground, the QUWA wordmark set left, a single #ff6b2c accent rule, generous negative space. Type only.
